final: WITH exec_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) as exec_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), total_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM orderexecutions), shares AS (SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, CAST(exec_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share FROM exec_counts), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), with_diff AS (SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val) as diff FROM shares) SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, diff FROM with_diff ORDER BY CASE WHEN ordersmark IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, diff DESC LIMIT 10
